run_fh_mask_coco: run the CLI tool to compute Felzenszwalb-Huttenlocher segmentation masks for all JPG images in a COCO image folder
run_compute_fh_segmentation: run compute_fh_segmentation on a numpy image array with custom scales and min_sizes to get stacked segmentation masks
run_process_single_image: run _process_image on a single JPG file path to generate and save a Felzenszwalb segmentation NPY file
refactor_fh_scales: refactor the tool to accept Felzenszwalb scale and min_size parameters as lists instead of comma-separated strings
review_main: review the main function to understand how it resolves paths, validates folders, and launches multiprocessing for batch segmentation
